# The ManKind Project Polska (MKP Polska)

> Independent nonprofit running peer-led men's circles and the NWTA initiation
> training for men in Poland. Part of The ManKind Project, founded 1985, active
> in 27 countries, with more than 70,000 men having completed the NWTA.

The website is published in five languages. Content is identical across them.

- [Polski (default)](/): Męskie kręgi i trening inicjacyjny NWTA
- [English](/en): Men's circles and the NWTA initiation training
- [Deutsch](/de): Männerkreise und das Initiationstraining NWTA
- [Čeština](/cs): Mužské kruhy a iniciační trénink NWTA
- [Українська](/uk): Чоловічі кола та ініціаційний тренінг NWTA

## What the organization offers

- **Men's circles (I-Groups)**: closed, peer-facilitated groups meeting weekly
  with a fixed structure. Core rule is "No Fixing" — members listen without
  giving advice. What is said in the circle stays in the circle. No fee is
  charged for participation in a circle.
- **New Warrior Training Adventure (NWTA)**: a 48-hour weekend initiation
  training modelled on the classic hero's journey. It is an experience, not a
  lecture or a motivational workshop.
- **Integration**: after the training, men return to a circle where the
  experience becomes daily practice — honesty, accountability, integrity.

## Next NWTA training

- Dates: 2–4 October 2026
- Location: Kiczyce, Cieszyn Silesia, Poland
- Led by: Thomas Filler and an international MKP staff
- Language: English, with translators on site

## Facts

- The ManKind Project was founded in 1985 in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.
- More than 70,000 men have completed the NWTA.
- The organization is active in 27 countries and is a nonprofit.
- Mission: "We believe that emotionally mature, powerful, compassionate, and
  purpose-driven men will help heal some of our society's deepest wounds."
- MKP is not a religious or political organization, and circles do not replace
  therapy or medical treatment.
